name: Mental & Physical Availability Engine
diagnostic: Is our brand both mentally available (easily recalled in a buying situation) and physically available (accessible to purchase with minimal friction)?
artifact: A Dual-Availability Performance Index tracking mental metrics (salience, cue ownership) and physical metrics (channel distribution, shelf prominence, checkout friction).
trap: Focusing exclusively on deep emotional loyalty among existing users while neglecting broad category mental reach and physical distribution.
pedigreeFull: Byron Sharp (*How Brands Grow*, 2010; Ehrenberg-Bass Institute).
